newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price -USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Wednesday that around 1,400 head were exported into the United States at three crossing points Tuesday, with prices ranging on weight.
Through Nogales, Arizona, around 500 head were sold at steady prices for feeder steers and steer calves.
"Trade moderate, demand good. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," the USDA said.
Prices for 300-400 lb feeder steers were between 73-83 cents /lb and for 400-500 lb head they were between 68-73 cents/lb.

Through Laredo, Texas, around 600 head were sold, but not enough to establish trend or quotes prices. "Ninety percent of cattle crossed were previously contracted or retained by owners. Supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500lbs," USDA said.
Through Santa Teresa, New Mexico, around 300 head crossed, although not enough to establish trend prices.
